en.title: Ukraine launches record drone raid while peace talks proceed with US and EU
en.dek: Ukrainian forces hit Russian energy and transport infrastructure in a record drone attack on 16 November as diplomatic discussions involving U.S. and European officials continue.
facts: Russia's Defense Ministry reported shooting down 1,336 Ukrainian drones in a single night.
Ukraine hit 27 of 32 Russian oil refineries, disabling over 55 percent of refining capacity, according to President Zelenskyy.
U.S. envoy Jared Kushner stated on 17 November that progress is being made toward an agreement to end the war.
The Kremlin stated that Europe's role in upcoming peace negotiations has not been agreed upon.
European Commission officials plan to propose a €45 billion loan for Ukraine backed by the EU budget.
body: Ukrainian forces launched their largest drone attack against Russia since the war began, according to Russian defense ministry data reported on 16 November. Russia's Ministry of Defense stated that air defenses intercepted 1,336 Ukrainian drones overnight, including strikes targeting the Crimean Bridge that forced a temporary halt to traffic. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Ukraine's drone campaign has struck 27 of Russia's 32 oil refineries, disabling over 55 percent of the country's refining capacity. Bloomberg estimated the offline capacity at nearly 40 percent.

President Zelenskyy confirmed on 16 November that Ukrainian officials held new discussions on peace prospects with U.S. and European representatives. U.S. envoy Jared Kushner stated on X that progress is being made toward an agreement to end the war, although important challenges remain. The Kremlin contradicted U.S. statements regarding the format of discussions, stating that Europe's participation in the next round of peace talks has not been agreed upon.

Diplomatic discussions follow a U.S. proposal suggesting Ukraine surrender territory in the Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership, according to President Zelenskyy. Zelenskyy stated that Russia rejected a proposed energy truce and continues to receive dozens of North Korean ballistic missiles monthly while expanding domestic missile production. The Kremlin announced that Russian President Vladimir Putin could meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un at the upcoming Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit.

European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen announced that Europe intends to engage in peace negotiations. The European Commission plans to propose a €45 billion loan for Ukraine backed by the EU budget, though Czechia and Slovakia object to the proposal, according to official reports. EUobserver reported that the European Union's mandate for peace talks is taking shape amid the ongoing military escalation.

Russian aerial strikes killed two people and injured at least 12 across Ukraine on 16 November, according to regional authorities. Strikes damaged energy facilities in Cherkasy and hit locations in Dnipro and Zaporizhzhia, as reported by The Kyiv Post. Ukrainian forces also targeted the Akhtubinsk military airfield and petrochemical enterprises in Nizhnekamsk overnight on 15 November, triggering ammunition detonations and a plant fire.

President Zelenskyy urged the United States and Elon Musk to lift restrictions on Starshield satellite terminals, stating the limitations hinder Ukraine's ability to intercept Russian drones and protect energy infrastructure. Meanwhile, three merchant ships were struck by drones in the Black Sea near a Romanian shipping canal on 15 November, according to CNA. Romanian Prime Minister Luca Niculescu stated the strikes violate international law, while Russia denied targeting neighboring countries.
en.context: Ukraine and Russia have escalated long-range drone and missile strikes against military, energy, and transport infrastructure. Parallel diplomatic efforts involving U.S., European, and Ukrainian officials continue despite disagreements over territorial terms and negotiation formats.

en.title: Ukraine strikes Crimean Bridge as European leaders prepare for peace talks
en.dek: Ukrainian forces hit the Crimean Bridge on 16 November while European officials prepare to engage in peace negotiations.
facts: Russia reported the interception of over 1,300 Ukrainian drones during an aerial attack on 16 November.
Ukraine struck the bridge linking Russia and Crimea on 16 November, forcing a temporary traffic halt.
European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen announced Europe will engage in upcoming peace negotiations.
President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reported that Russia launched over 2,300 strike drones and 15 missiles against Ukraine in the past week.
U.S. negotiators proposed that Ukraine surrender Donbas territory in exchange for NATO membership, according to President Zelenskyy.
body: Russia stated that its air defenses intercepted over 1,300 Ukrainian drones during an aerial attack on 16 November, according to official reports. The barrage included strikes targeting the Crimean Bridge, which forced a temporary halt to traffic, as reported by Die Zeit and Der Spiegel.

Ukraine carried out the drone attack on the bridge connecting Russia and Crimea, according to France 24 and Kurdistan24. Russian-backed governor Sergei Aksyonov confirmed the strike forced a closure and delayed four trains, as reported by The Kyiv Post.

European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen stated that Europe will closely engage in upcoming peace negotiations between Russia and Ukraine. This announcement follows reports regarding potential discussions about territorial settlements, according to reports from Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty.

President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that U.S. negotiators suggested Ukraine surrender territory in the Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership. Zelenskyy also reported that Russia rejected a proposed energy truce and that restrictions on Starshield satellite terminals are hindering Ukraine's energy defenses.

Ukrainian forces struck the Akhtubinsk military airfield and petrochemical enterprises in Nizhnekamsk overnight on 15 November, according to the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. These strikes triggered ammunition detonations at the airfield and caused a fire at a petrochemical plant, as reported by The Kyiv Independent.

Three ships were struck by drones in the Black Sea near a Romanian shipping canal on 15 November, according to CNA. Prime Minister Luca Niculescu stated the incidents violate international law, while Russia denied targeting Ukraine's neighbors with drones, as reported by The Straits Times.

Britain's Prince Harry met wounded soldiers during a two-day visit to Lviv, according to The Guardian and The Straits Times. The Duke of Sussex expressed confidence that Ukraine would win the war and discussed the Invictus Games.
Estonia's Foreign Minister stated there is evidence of a Russian sabotage attack against a drone manufacturer and intends to close all border crossings with Russia, according to FAZ.
en.context: The conflict continues with ongoing air attacks and diplomatic discussions regarding territorial concessions. Ukraine and Russia have traded strikes on military and industrial infrastructure throughout the region.

de.title: Ukraine greift Krim-Brücke an, während sich europäische Staats- und Regierungschefs auf Friedensgespräche vorbereiten
de.dek: Ukrainische Streitkräfte trafen am 16. November die Krim-Brücke, während sich europäische Amtsträger auf die Aufnahme von Friedensverhandlungen vorbereiten.
facts: Russland meldete die Abwehr von über 1.300 ukrainischen Drohnen bei einem Luftangriff am 16. November.
Die Ukraine traf am 16. November die Brücke, die Russland mit der Krim verbindet, was eine vorübergehende Verkehrssperre erzwang.
EU-Kommissionspräsidentin Ursula von der Leyen kündigte an, dass Europa an den bevorstehenden Friedensverhandlungen teilnehmen werde.
Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj berichtete, dass Russland in der vergangenen Woche über 2.300 Angriffsdrohnen und 15 Raketen gegen die Ukraine eingesetzt habe.
US-Unterhändler schlugen laut Präsident Selenskyj vor, dass die Ukraine Gebiete im Donbas im Austausch für eine NATO-Mitgliedschaft abtritt.
body: Russland erklärte offiziellen Berichten zufolge, dass seine Luftabwehr bei einem Luftangriff am 16. November über 1.300 ukrainische Drohnen abgefangen habe. Der Angriff umfasste Schläge gegen die Krim-Brücke, die laut Die Zeit und Der Spiegel eine vorübergehende Einstellung des Verkehrs erzwangen.

Die Ukraine führte den Drohnenangriff auf die Brücke zwischen Russland und der Krim durch, wie France 24 und Kurdistan24 berichteten. Der russisch unterstützte Gouverneur Sergei Aksjonow bestätigte, dass der Angriff eine Sperrung erzwang und vier Züge verzögerte, wie The Kyiv Post meldete.

EU-Kommissionspräsidentin Ursula von der Leyen erklärte, dass Europa sich eng in die bevorstehenden Friedensverhandlungen zwischen Russland und der Ukraine einbringen werde. Diese Ankündigung folgt auf Berichte über mögliche Diskussionen zu territorialen Regelungen, wie Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty berichtete.

Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj erklärte, US-Unterhändler hätten vorgeschlagen, dass die Ukraine Gebiete in der Region Donbas im Austausch für eine NATO-Mitgliedschaft abtrete. Selenskyj berichtete zudem, dass Russland eine vorgeschlagene Energiewaffenruhe abgelehnt habe und dass Einschränkungen bei Starshield-Satellitenterminals die Energieverteidigung der Ukraine behinderten.

Ukrainische Streitkräfte trafen in der Nacht zum 15. November den Militärflugplatz Achtubinsk und petrochemische Unternehmen in Nischnekamsk, so der Generalstab der ukrainischen Streitkräfte. Diese Angriffe lösten Munitionsexplosionen auf dem Flugplatz aus und verursachten einen Brand in einem petrochemischen Werk, wie The Kyiv Independent berichtete.

Drei Schiffe wurden am 15. November im Schwarzen Meer in der Nähe eines rumänischen Schifffahrtskanals von Drohnen getroffen, so CNA. Premierminister Luca Niculescu erklärte, die Vorfälle verstießen gegen internationales Recht, während Russland bestritt, die Nachbarn der Ukraine mit Drohnen angegriffen zu haben, wie The Straits Times berichtete.

Der britische Prinz Harry traf während eines zweitägigen Besuchs in Lwiw verwundete Soldaten, so The Guardian und The Straits Times. Der Herzog von Sussex äußerte sich zuversichtlich, dass die Ukraine den Krieg gewinnen werde, und sprach über die Invictus Games.
Der estnische Außenminister erklärte, es gebe Beweise für einen russischen Sabotageakt gegen einen Drohnenhersteller und beabsichtige, alle Grenzübergänge zu Russland zu schließen, so die FAZ.
de.context: Der Konflikt dauert mit anhaltenden Luftangriffen und diplomatischen Diskussionen über territoriale Zugeständnisse an. Die Ukraine und Russland haben sich gegenseitig mit Schlägen gegen militärische und industrielle Infrastruktur in der gesamten Region überzogen.

facts: Estonia's Foreign Minister stated there is evidence of a Russian sabotage attack against a drone manufacturer, according to FAZ.
Estonia intends to close all border crossings with Russia, according to the country's Foreign Minister.

Ukrainian forces struck the Akhtubinsk military airfield and petrochemical enterprises in Nizhnekamsk overnight on 15 November, according to the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and Russian officials.
Three ships were struck by drones in the Black Sea near a Romanian shipping canal on 15 November, according to CNA.
President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that restrictions on Starshield terminals are hindering Ukraine's energy defenses ahead of winter.
U.S. negotiators suggested that Ukraine surrender territory in the Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership, according to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
body: Estonia's Foreign Minister stated on 15 November there is evidence of a Russian sabotage attack against a drone manufacturer, according to FAZ. The minister indicated the country intends to close all border crossings with Russia.

Ukrainian forces struck the Akhtubinsk military airfield in the Astrakhan region and petrochemical enterprises in Nizhnekamsk overnight on 15 November, according to the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and Russian officials. The strikes caused a fire at a petrochemical plant and triggered ammunition detonations at the airfield.

Three ships were struck by drones in the Black Sea near a Romanian shipping canal on 15 November, according to CNA. Prime Minister Luca Niculescu stated the incidents violate international law, while Russia denied targeting Ukraine's neighbors with drones, as reported by The Straits Times.

President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated on 15 November that restrictions on Starshield terminals are hindering Ukraine's energy defenses ahead of winter. According to reports from the BBC and the South China Morning Post, the Ukrainian president has urged the United States and Elon Musk to lift these limitations.

U.S. negotiators suggested that Ukraine surrender territory in the Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership, according to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Zelenskyy stated that Russia also rejected a proposed energy truce.

Russia and Ukraine traded air attacks as U.S.-mediated negotiations failed to break the diplomatic deadlock, according to Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty. Fox News reported that negotiations regarding the war have expanded to include European nations.
en.context: On 15 November, Ukrainian forces struck Russian military and industrial sites including the Akhtubinsk airfield and petrochemical plants in Nizhnekamsk, while drone attacks hit ships in the Black Sea near Romania. Estonia's Foreign Minister cited evidence of Russian sabotage as grounds for considering border closures. Diplomatic efforts regarding territorial concessions and air defense capabilities continued amid the ongoing conflict.

de.title: Estland erwägt Grenzschließung während Drohnenangriffe Russland und das Schwarze Meer treffen
de.dek: Estland plant die Schließung von Grenzübergängen zu Russland nach mutmaßlicher Sabotage, während Drohnenangriffe auf russische Militärstandorte und das Schwarze Meer andauern.
facts: Estland beabsichtigt laut dem Außenminister des Landes, alle Grenzübergänge zu Russland zu schließen.
Estlands Außenminister erklärte, es gebe Beweise für einen russischen Sabotageakt gegen einen Drohnenhersteller.
Ukrainische Streitkräfte griffen am 15. November den Militärflugplatz Achtubinsk sowie petrochemische Anlagen in Russland an.
Drei Schiffe wurden am 15. November im Schwarzen Meer in der Nähe eines rumänischen Schifffahrtskanals von Drohnen getroffen.
Präsident Selenskyj erklärte, US-Unterhändler hätten vorgeschlagen, dass die Ukraine Gebiete im Donbas gegen eine NATO-Mitgliedschaft abtritt.
body: Estland beabsichtigt, alle Grenzübergänge zu Russland zu schließen, wie der Außenminister des Landes am 15. November mitteilte. Der Minister berichtete laut FAZ von Beweisen für einen russischen Sabotageakt gegen einen Drohnenhersteller.

Ukrainische Streitkräfte griffen in der Nacht zum 15. November den Militärflugplatz Achtubinsk in der Region Astrachan sowie petrochemische Unternehmen in Nischnekamsk an, so der Generalstab der ukrainischen Streitkräfte und russische Beamte. Die Angriffe verursachten einen Brand in einer petrochemischen Anlage und lösten Munitionsexplosionen auf dem Flugplatz aus.

Drei Schiffe wurden am 15. November im Schwarzen Meer in der Nähe eines rumänischen Schifffahrtskanals von Drohnen getroffen, wie CNA berichtete. Premierminister Luca Niculescu erklärte, die Vorfälle verstießen gegen internationales Recht, während Russland laut The Straits Times bestritt, Nachbarländer der Ukraine mit Drohnen angegriffen zu haben.

Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj erklärte, dass Einschränkungen bei Starshield-Terminals die Energieverteidigung der Ukraine vor dem Winter behindern. Er berichtete, dass russische Streitkräfte in der vergangenen Woche über 2.300 Angriffsdrohnen und 15 Raketen gegen die Ukraine eingesetzt hätten.

US-Unterhändler schlugen laut Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj vor, dass die Ukraine Gebiete in der Donbas-Region im Austausch für eine NATO-Mitgliedschaft abtritt. Selenskyj gab an, dass Russland zudem einen Vorschlag für einen Energiewaffenstillstand abgelehnt habe.

Russland und die Ukraine tauschten Luftangriffe aus, während die von den USA vermittelten Verhandlungen laut Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty scheiterten, die diplomatische Sackgasse zu durchbrechen. Fox News berichtete, dass die Verhandlungen über den Krieg auf europäische Nationen ausgeweitet wurden.
de.context: Die Angriffe vom 15. November folgen auf eine Reihe ukrainischer Drohnenangriffe auf russische Militär- und Industrieanlagen. Die diplomatischen Bemühungen bezüglich territorialer Zugeständnisse und Luftverteidigungskapazitäten dauern angesichts des nahenden Winters an.

en.title: Ukrainian drones strike Russian sites; Zelenskyy urges end to Starshield limits
en.dek: Ukraine struck Russian airfields and petrochemical plants overnight, while Zelenskyy pressed the U.S. to lift Starshield restrictions ahead of winter.
facts: Ukrainian drones struck the Akhtubinsk military airfield in Astrakhan region and petrochemical enterprises in Nizhnekamsk overnight on Nov. 15, causing fires and ammunition detonations, according to the Ukrainian General Staff and Russian officials.
Russian forces launched over 2,300 strike drones and 15 missiles against Ukraine over the past week, Zelenskyy reported.
U.S. negotiators suggested Ukraine surrender Donbas territory in exchange for NATO membership, according to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
Zelenskyy stated that Russia also rejected a proposed energy truce.
Zelenskyy said restrictions on Starshield terminals are hindering Ukraine's energy defenses ahead of winter.
At least 30 explosions were heard at the Akhtubinsk airfield following the Ukrainian strike.
body: Ukrainian forces struck the Akhtubinsk military airfield in the Astrakhan region and petrochemical enterprises in Nizhnekamsk overnight on Nov. 15, according to the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and Russian officials. The strikes caused a fire at a petrochemical plant and triggered ammunition detonations at the airfield.

Russian forces launched over 2,300 strike drones and 15 missiles against Ukraine over the past week, Zelenskyy reported, as he called for an end to Starshield restrictions that he said are hindering Ukraine's energy defenses ahead of winter.

U.S. negotiators suggested that Ukraine surrender territory in the Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership, according to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Zelenskyy stated that Russia also rejected a proposed energy truce.

Zelenskyy said restrictions on Starshield terminals are hindering Ukraine's energy defenses ahead of winter, warning that the limitations threaten Ukraine's ability to protect its energy infrastructure as cold weather approaches.
en.context: The Nov. 15 strikes mark the latest in a series of Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian military and industrial sites, while diplomatic efforts continue over territorial concessions and air defense capabilities ahead of winter.
